Payment posting date
Created date
Balance date (recommended)
info
The date Synder uses for payments, refunds and other Stripe balance transactions: Balance date, when the money reaches your Stripe balance, or Created date, when Stripe created the transaction. Invoices follow the Invoice date setting on the Invoices tab. Learn more →
Applied Balance Account
Stripe sales
info
Used to record Stripe customer applied balances when they reduce an invoice or payment total. Synder uses this account to create and map the 'Stripe applied balance' item.
